fusions.name: Recited Formula
fusions.desc: A brass cylinder recites a formula as a bolt that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Punch-Card Barrage
fusions.desc: Feeds a punch card through a casting engine that looses 3 bolts, and each one deals 2 damage to the enemy it strikes.

fusions.name: Rehearsal Metronome
fusions.desc: Sets a metronome ticking at your practised tempo, raising your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Memorised Sequence
fusions.desc: Every ability you use adds a step to the sequence on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per step (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a step fades every 6 seconds.
